column1: # Rule registry — one owner per rule.

# owner: scan = ui-design-review/scripts/scan.sh (already implemented, not re-implemented) · detect = Node static engine · browser = opt-in rendered pass · tokens = ui-design-system/scripts/validate-tokens.py · judgement = adjudicated by distinctiveness-review against its references/gates.md (no machine check)

# origin: H<n> = upstream slop gate n · I3 = upstream detector rule (v3.9.1) · I4 = upstream detector rule new in v4.5.2 · kit = this kit's own · S = upstream /slop review item · upstream sources are credited in NOTICE
# status: live = exists today in scan.sh / validate-tokens · todo = not yet implemented · n/a = judgement only

column8: heuristic
font family not declared in DESIGN.md / tokens (verify validate-tokens covers literal families in 1b; else move to detect)
literal colour not in the token set
literal radius not on the radius scale
literal font-size or clamp() endpoint (px/rem/pt) > 0.5px off the ramp in tokens.json / DESIGN.md (--design, else nearest up to the scan target); no ramp → silent
style="" colour/font literal when the page has colour/font tokens; component-level literal equal to a token's value
≥2 hairline `Npx, transparent Npx` stops + background-size
top/bottom border ≥2px coloured, ≥2× other sides, on radius > 0
Colored side-stripe border
Ghost-card pattern (border + wide shadow)
repeating-linear-gradient stripes as fill
Glassmorphism on content surface / "Translucent content-surface fill"
Border radius > 16px on card/container
crude illustration makes the page feel unfinished
h2–h4 ≥20px preceded by 2–34-char uppercase/small-caps label ≤16px, tracking ≥0.06em; excl. Step N, short numbers, dates. Hero h1 case stays with scan "Eyebrow above the hero H1"
Eyebrow above the hero H1
interactive/content text < 11px (10px legal smallprint); body text > 20 chars < 12px → warning
≥3 distinct sizes and largest ÷ smallest < 2.0
32–128px ~square tile with bg/border holding an icon directly above a heading
italic on h1–h3 or display text (≥32px); serif ≥48px states it as the AI tell
pill badge before h1 — covered by "Eyebrow above the hero H1" (verify chip form in 1b)
Oversized display clamp (advisory)
letter-spacing ≤ −0.05em on text > 20 chars
Generic font as primary design choice / "Saturated AI-default font"
> 3 font families in use (mono counts)
a family that is neither body (root rules) nor display (h1–h3 / display rules) declared in > 2 rules
one family everywhere with no size/weight contrast (one family is often right on Operate surfaces)
All-caps on body text
Display line-height below 1.0
line-height < 1.3 on body text (not headings)
letter-spacing > 0.05em on non-uppercase body text
text-align: justify without hyphens: auto
display heading (≥48px) without overflow-wrap: anywhere / break-word
dark page; radial gradient first stop alpha ≥0.7 fading to ≤0.05, no tight px stop, no url()
faint coloured radial on ≥240×160 box that text overlaps
saturated hue 260–310 on headings/large text; purple→blue/cyan/pink gradients
Glow used as elevation / "Offsetless glow shadow"
Gradient text (absolute ban)
low-chroma grey text on a background whose stops all have chroma ≥40
Warm/cream background token
page base background/ink exactly #000 or #fff (genre-dependent: advisory)
every neutral token has chroma 0 (untinted greys)
static (detect batch 1); rendered composited check = measure-contrast.mjs (exists): resolved fg/bg pair below 4.5 / 3.0 large; browser pass re-checks against computed backgrounds
fills matching --accent / --brand / --primary cover > 5% of any viewport band (no accent token → silent)
Numbered section markers (AI tell)
card in a horizontal scroller < 8px from the scroller edge where that edge also meets the screen edge (in-column rails aligned to the text are deliberate); sweep widths

text under an opaque layer (bg α ≥ 0.5, image, media, backdrop blur ≥ 4px) or blurred ≥ 4px; full-screen layers waited out for 3s, then reported once; pinned chrome only counts at rest; consent UI excluded
one column > 1.4× viewport tall while its sibling ≤ 1×
space above heading < 0.75× space below (deficit ≥12px) on ≥2 headings
huge number + small stats as the hero template; bare number as whole headline
three equal cards, icon above heading; every point given equal weight
hero → 3 features → CTA → footer, or the last build's structure repeated (log-checked)
≥10 spacing values (rounded to 4), one > 60%, ≤3 unique
card-like element with ≥10 chars inside another card-like element; innermost only; skip dialogs/menus/positioned
static: p/li/dd/blockquote ≥160 chars whose estimated measure at a 1280px viewport (container width ÷ 0.5em) exceeds 85 chars; browser pass measures real chars/line

heading text clipped horizontally by overflow hidden/clip (excluding explicit ellipsis/clamp), or page scrollWidth − clientWidth ≥ 16px at any sweep width (320 / 768 / 1280 / 1920, plus 1px either side of DESIGN.md breakpoints); names the outermost overflowing elements
overflow hidden/clip cutting an absolutely positioned interactive child
grid-template-columns with bare 1fr in a grid that holds images (use minmax(0,1fr))
two sticky elements at top: 0 where one is the nav
static half of gate 44 already in scan.sh
extend measure-padding.mjs (exists) — padding < max(4, 0.3×font) vertical or max(8, 0.5×font) horizontal in a bordered/filled box
p/li > 40 chars spanning > 50% of the viewport, text lines within 16px of the screen edge; text running off screen is content-overflow's
default AI nav (wordmark + links + CTA) / four-column link footer
infinite opacity/shadow/scale animation on a 2–16px round element; error inside header/nav; skip reduced-motion blocks
infinite blink on a caret-sized non-editable element
<marquee> or infinite keyframes translating X ≥20% with no pause control
Bounce/elastic easing / "Bounce easing via cubic-bezier overshoot"
Layout property animation (v4 retired it as rarely harmful — keep, kit rule)
Image scale/rotate on hover (v4 retired it — review severity in 1b)
transition: all / transition-property: all
transition on outline/box-shadow that applies to :focus / :focus-visible
one :hover rule changes ≥3 of transform, shadow, background, colour, border
Motion with no reduced-motion fallback
same string ≥3× in ≥3 different slots of one card
Em-dash overuse (AI copy tell)
Marketing buzzword in UI copy
≥3 "Not X. Y." / "X. Just Y." constructions in page text
dismissive "X theater" phrasing
Jane/John Doe, Acme, Lorem ipsum in shipped copy
cliché opening lines ("Built for the modern…", "Where X meets Y") — list kept in a data file, not an always-loaded reference
invented metrics, customers, testimonials, prices; synthetic demo data unlabelled
inline SVG ≥200×200, ≥8 primitives, ≥3 fills, ≤2 text, no pattern
clip-path path() with ≥3 curves or polygon() with ≥10 off-grid vertices
url() background under a preceding gradient whose stops are all ≥0.9 alpha, no blend mode
Broken/placeholder image src
inline svg/canvas with no aria-label, aria-labelledby, role=img+title, or aria-hidden
video autoplay without muted, or without poster
Lottie where CSS/SVG would do
Emoji as chrome icon
fake browser bars, phone frames, IDE windows
uncaught exception on load
after a scroll-through: ≥ 200 chars, ≥ 150 never visible while on screen, > 30% of the page's text (scroll-linked fades and working reveals pass; closed dialogs / menus / consent UI excluded)
heading level jumps by more than one
:focus changes border-width; disabled styled by opacity only
button / role=button / submit / button-like or nav-header link label renders on > 1 line at any sweep width; links in prose may wrap; separate block title/description rows are composite controls
radio-hack tabs make the page jump
Hardcoded spacing bypasses the scale (a file that declares a --space-* scale uses a literal)
every hero element on one centred axis, or a full-height centred hero carrying one line
one hover treatment (scale, lift, glow) applied to unrelated kinds of element
celebration (toast, confetti, burst) for a change the screen already shows
tooltip waits as long on keyboard focus as on hover
content advanced by script with no pause or stop control (CSS loops are marquee's)
focus not visible (a browser default ring counts), or a pressable / disableable control with no state for it
abstract backdrop with > 1 colour, > 5% of the view, or animated mesh, and no job (page glow tokens are scan's; radial halo / spotlight are detect / browser)
icons from more than one library or drawing style on one page (emoji as chrome is scan's)
highlighter band or decorative underline on words that carry no emphasis, or set off the text it marks
mixed-height items in one row not aligned on a deliberate axis
input and button heights differ in one row; focus shown by changing the border; helper slot collapses (border-width shift and opacity-only disabled are input-state-shift's)
hero does not fit the first 1280×800 view (bottom-heavy padding is scan's)
ornament with no job the page or its contract can name
two-column section head that does not stack on a phone
a supplied direction diluted toward a generic default look
same structure or same component variation settings as a recent build (build log), or a build record disagreeing with the page; no log → not assessable
the first idea for the product category, or a performed avoidance of it that is its own cliché
on an Operate or Read surface, a borrowed world reaches past type, palette, density and one signature move
AI product: the category's stock icon (sparkle, star, wand, orb) marking generated content or as the brand mark; generated content not distinguished at all
AI product: a conversation column chosen because the product is AI, not because the task is dialogue
AI product: a centred prompt box with a suggestion-chip row (or a glow behind the input) is the page's whole identity
AI product: model-name or powered-by badges the user cannot act on
AI product: agent steps or streamed output left undesigned (console dump, typing dots, a spinner where real steps could be named)
AI product: anthropomorphic filler ("Let me take a look…") standing in for character
a relative href (not #, a scheme, // or root-relative /) that resolves to no file beside the page; a folder resolves to its index.html, and an existing folder without one is not reported
the first family of rendered text is neither generic nor a common system face, and after document.fonts.ready it does not render (canvas width equals each generic fallback): declared but never loaded
